change: FITS-to-display replay from recorded processing context, used by authenticated FITS preview when a matching complete image recipe is present.

proof: 96 full-frame pixel comparisons across two camera identities, uint8 RGB/uint16 CFA/float32 FITS, day/night, calibrated/pre-dark/stack/focus and all four supported stretch variants.
AWB numerical behavior compared with the frozen pre-extraction method across integer/floating types, ranges and initialization states.
Saved actual AWB/CCM, denoise gate, cached LUTs, masks, detections, presentation and labels reproduce captured pixels; source file bytes remain unchanged.
Gzip representation produces identical display pixels.
Actual Flask preview requires login and returns the expected encoded JPEG for admin and ordinary user without a permanent JPEG file.
Wrong camera/source, changed source bytes, corrupt assets and ambiguous matching image records are rejected. FITS original download still succeeds after recipe failure.
tests.explanation: The full 190-case run used unchanged application sources. One historical whole-class fingerprint rejected the intentional new preview branch. Only that test was updated to pin and normalize the new branch, preserving its original legacy fingerprint; its entire entrypoint then passed. Hash comparison proves this test is the sole source difference. The original failed report is preserved.

intentional_correction.problem: Real 12-bit denoise output exceeded 4095 and mode-1 stretch failed with an out-of-bounds LUT index.
intentional_correction.behavior: Display denoise clamps integer results to effective camera bit depth. In-range pixels are unchanged; FITS scientific data is not modified.

storage_tradeoff: Ordinary calibrated single frames use their FITS directly. Pre-calibration and stacked modes retain a lossless prepared scientific array; forecast and retention must account for these non-evictable dependencies.
deployment: Not deployed. Production stays 0cf2de6e/application 994ac136, with its current capture/storage policy.
limits: The final recipe currently resides on the matching image database record; portable FITS recipe publication is not complete.
Bounded derivative caching, asset lifecycle, generated-media readers, configurable day/night policy, external mounts and storage forecast remain required before activation.
This isolated verification is not live production acceptance and does not complete the overall migration/acceptance goal.
